decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage removed the genuinely near-empty counts of the 4-5 June 2016 East Coast Low storm; the counter was working.
decisions.evidence: Raw site totals 99 (Sat 4th) and 28 (Sun 5th) with sparse non-zero slots through the day in both directions; neighbours fell the same way (568: 86/31, 544: 126/55, 542: 249/135) against ~800-1200 on surrounding weekdays.

decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage removed real low counts on the 9 Feb 2020 heavy-rain Sunday and the following early morning.
decisions.evidence: 332 raw 62 on 2020-02-09 with 0-4 per slot all day, same pattern as 333 (72, kept); 02-10 morning zeros are normal overnight and the day is 581 vs 333 558.

decisions.diagnosis: Overnight/early-morning Sunday zeros flagged as outage; the counter was working.
decisions.evidence: Only zeros removed (raw 182 = clean 182); slots 04:00-07:00 Sunday, 332 had 0-3 per slot at the same time.

decisions.diagnosis: Saturday small-hours zeros flagged as outage; the counter was working.
decisions.evidence: Only zeros removed (raw 229 = clean 229), slots 00:00-05:45; normal counts follow.

decisions.diagnosis: Christmas Day afternoon lull flagged as outage.
decisions.evidence: Only 5 zero slots removed (raw 73 = clean 73); 333 105 same day, low Christmas traffic.

decisions.diagnosis: Sunday early-morning zeros flagged as outage; the counter was working.
decisions.evidence: Only 6 zero slots (07:15-08:30 Sun) removed, raw 295 = clean 295; counts either side normal.

decisions.diagnosis: Southbound counted large spurious midday volumes (likely non-bike detections such as works activity) that neither the northbound direction nor nearby sites show.
decisions.evidence: 333/332 daily ratio 2.66, 1.74, 1.66, 2.14, 2.34 (e.g. 1781 vs 670 on 12-17, midday slots 40-80 per 15 min vs a normal 5-15) against a usual ratio ~1.0-1.05; week total 6277 vs 3155; 544 fell over the same week.

decisions.diagnosis: Same spurious southbound midday/afternoon excess as in mid-December 2018.
decisions.evidence: 333 1001 vs 332 517 (ratio 1.94), excess concentrated 12:00-18:00 at 20-50 per slot.

decisions.diagnosis: Throughout this window southbound sporadically carries extra midday/afternoon counts on weekdays that may be spurious detections.
decisions.evidence: Weekday 333/332 ratios 1.3-1.5 on 2018-12-24, 2019-01-22..24, 02-06, 02-21, 02-25 (ratio otherwise 0.9-1.1 across 2015-2025); not seen at neighbouring sites.

decisions.diagnosis: One of two channels is duplicated in every slot (3 records per slot) and was not removed by duplicate_load, so the day is overcounted by about 5%.
decisions.evidence: Records per slot like 33/1/1, 3/24/3; cleaned 854, sum of duplicated copies 43, so true total ~811 (332 same day 854 after dedup).

series.name: Northbound (Ecocounter, 2015-2025)
series.evidence: Original Ecocounter northbound; kept separate from the MetroCount replacement because levels are not comparable across the switch.

series.name: Northbound (MetroCount, 2025-)
series.evidence: Replacement counter after a 5-month gap reads ~39% higher (Nov 2024 1280/day both directions vs Nov 2025 1780); nearby City of Sydney sites replaced at the same time jump similarly (544 +45%, 542 +38%, 552 +90%), pointing to a counter/method change rather than growth, so no overlap exists to calibrate.

series.name: Southbound (MetroCount, 2025-)
series.evidence: As for northbound: same direction label and split as 333, but not comparable in level to the Ecocounter.

summary: Kent St (E) south of Druitt St has an Ecocounter from Dec 2015 to May 2025 (with outages in Apr-Jun 2019, Apr-May 2021, Nov 2022-Aug 2023 and May-Aug 2025 that the automatic fixes already handle) and a MetroCount from Oct 2025 that reads about 40% higher, like other City of Sydney replacements, so the two are kept as separate series. The main changes: restore the June 2016 storm days and a few genuine low-count days that zero_outage removed, and set missing the southbound days in Dec 2018-Jan 2019 that carry spurious midday counts. The duplicate-channel days from 2022-2024 are correctly halved, apart from one partly duplicated southbound day on 2024-10-29.
